claims.claim_text: Architected a governed, policy-gated agent execution surface for regulated enterprise AI workflows, establishing L0 route-policy dispatch and runtime proof lineage as the control plane for agentic delivery.
Directed CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization by supporting partner-led deal cycles and usage-based subscription forecasting.
Established audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows through context engineering, runtime resilience controls, and rollback-ready telemetry.
Standardized the AI systems lifecycle from intake through production monitoring, compressing lab-to-production cycle time from six months to three weeks.
Architected cloud data and runtime integration patterns across Databricks Lakehouse, vector services, and API gateways to support distributed, high-availability agentic infrastructure.
Commercialized reusable agentic platform IP while scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28, building the operating model behind sustained platform growth.
